name: Box devtools semantics

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Box devtools semantics

Mechanism: store `DevtoolsFrameNode.semantics` as `Option<Box<DevtoolsSemantics>>` so the roughly 500-byte node shrinks and the spliced-stretch copy and frame-end drop move less memory. Allowed: crates/gpui/src/window.rs. Forbidden: any change to splice logic, devtools behaviour or other fields.
measurementPlanMarkdown: bm.sh e02: dashboard-clock, dashboard-one-panel, table-stream, text-typing, scroll-data-table, hover-grid, 3 reps. Pass: CPU/draw p50 at least -5% on dashboard-clock and table-stream with no allocation increase.

measurements.metric: dashboard-clock on CPU / draw p50 / allocs

reportMarkdown:
## Box devtools semantics Finished

Passed: false. CPU and draw time did not move beyond noise (about ±5% between runs) and allocations per frame rose 17-31% in fast mode on (the box is allocated for every element that carries semantics). The memmove in the splice copy is not dominated by the node size. Reverted.

Attempt Count: 1. Out-of-scope changes: none.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Reverted failure. Next: profile-driven candidates that remove work rather than shrink it.
